scope: K2 exploratory research on already exposed calibration originals; not formal training or independent evaluation

fit.weighting: each informative identity has total photo weight one; age-span leverage remains
fit.solution: d = sum_i mean_j(centered_age * centered_shape) / ((1 + alpha) * sum_i mean_j(centered_age^2))
fit.standardization: none; raw 40-dimensional shape space, no expression/projection predictors
fit.single_age_identities: retain records, exclude from fitting and fold age coverage
fit.failed_fits: retain requested rows and pairs; never impute coefficients

validation.outer: leave each pair-eligible calibration identity out
validation.inner: leave each informative identity in outer training out; choose alpha using only inner pairs
validation.objective: mean per-identity mean source-canonical neutral RMS, on exactly the same covered pairs for every alpha
validation.coverage: nonzero requests require source and target ages inside informative successful training age range; no clipping/extrapolation
validation.tie: isclose rtol=1e-12 atol=1e-15; prefer larger alpha
validation.full_fit: choose alpha by inner leave-identity-out on all calibration identities; full fit is exploratory only

geometry.definition: neutral geometry reconstructed in float64 from raw shape40 and pinned w_shp; not the old saved float32 neutral-vertex metric
geometry.metric: Gram([w_shp_first40, full_mapped_BFM_direction]) / vertex_count; original source canonical scale for every comparison
geometry.bfm: refit signed full-direction scalar using only each outer training fold under the same coefficient-derived geometry proxy
geometry.new_direction_bound: predicted displacement RMS cannot exceed the largest observed within-person displacement RMS in the training fold; no clipping
geometry.identity_proxy: same source frame; nearest other training identity at exactly the target label age; absent references stay unavailable

stability.definition: geometry-metric cosine and norm ratio of each outer direction to the full direction; not positive signs for every component
stability.research_direction_agreement_gate: all nonzero outer directions have strictly positive metric cosine to nonzero full direction; diagnostics only, not independent quality acceptance

anchors: always calculate from immutable original; exact known source-age reset; unknown absolute source age rejected; fractional ages preserved, finite 20-70 only; continuous within fold coverage and displacement bound
reporting: all requested pairs and failures retained; comparable summaries use the intersection of all three valid candidate outcomes; no age MAE or identity accuracy claim
selection: exploratory ranking only; Ridge requires positive direction agreement, BFM requires positive full and every outer beta; choose lowest common-pair macro RMS only when improving no_change, prefer static on numerical ties; no production selection
